newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen moving up on good company news.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen moving up on good company news.

text.p: Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) shares were expected to remain steady on Thursday, brokers said.
"I think the market will remain more or less steady amid strong presence of both buyers and sellers," said broker Khurshid Alam.
Broker Moshtaque Ahmed said market sentiment might remain positive and there was news that Olympic Industries was seeking foreign collaboration and might take up expansion programme.
The DSE benchmark index closed 9.26 points or 0.43 percent up at 2,137.39 on Wednesday.
